Stop.prompt: Did the assistant discover something non-obvious worth persisting as knowledge? (debugging insight, architectural pattern, user preference, API behavior). If yes, respond with {"ok": false, "reason": "Worth saving as [type]: [title] — [1-2 sentence summary]"}. If nothing worth saving, respond with {"ok": true}.

Check if a belt-managed skill was used AND improved during this session. Read the local skill files under ~/.claude/skills/ and compare with the published version via `belt skill use <namespace/name>`. If improved, show what changed and suggest `belt skill upload`. If not improved, do nothing.
